lignes.zh: 春天到了，树上长出了嫩绿的叶子。
lignes.pinyin: chūn tiān dào le shù shàng zhǎng chū le nèn lǜ de yè zi
lignes.fr: Le printemps arrive, les arbres se couvrent de feuilles vert tendre.
lignes.en: Spring is here and the trees are putting out tender green leaves.

lignes.zh: 小羊在草地上吃着嫩草。
lignes.pinyin: xiǎo yáng zài cǎo dì shàng chī zhe nèn cǎo
lignes.en: The lambs are eating the tender grass.

lignes.pinyin: kàn qǐ lai hěn kāi xīn
